research_question: Does the current decomposed generator create more consequential mathematical choices or invention opportunities than strong direct generation under common targets and prior knowledge?
hypothesis: Explicit design selection and data checking may support discovery-preserving tasks, but may also constrain the student's work or disclose the target; compare these separately rather than assuming decomposition helps.

calibration.purpose: Check execution and saved artifacts only; no prompt tuning or pooling with fresh results.

budget.derivation: Four possible proposals including two revisions, each with at most two schema attempts (8); three selections (3); three data calls (3); three writer calls (3). D1 is fixed, translation is disabled.
budget.monetary_cost: Provider prices unverified; no monetary estimate is claimed.

frozen_condition.prior: Identical fixed learner specification; D1 retrieval and recovery are not tested.
frozen_condition.direct_guidance: Existing strong direct prompt includes shared design-opportunity guidance and the same hypothetical example, but no expert task.
frozen_condition.pipeline: Current default design-brief/v2 with bounded revisions and retained usable drafts; no generation prompt edits.
frozen_condition.provenance: Per-case hashes, full source snapshots, exact prompts, fixed inputs and every request are preserved.
frozen_condition.expert_references: Existing normalized or reconstructed records used only as design anchors, not generation examples or exact student-text gold standards.

evaluation.type: Assistant task-text review with method labels hidden, plus shared exact mathematical checks where representable; not independent human blinding.

dimensions.mathematics: supported / invalid / unknown; check feasibility, arithmetic and necessary assumptions from final student text, not stage acceptance.
dimensions.target: preserved / narrowed / lost / unknown; distinguish one worked instance from the requested general procedure.
dimensions.accessible_start: yes / no / unknown from the supplied prior knowledge and required task inputs.
dimensions.disclosure: none / method / conclusion / both / unknown; useful definitions and permissions are not automatically hints.
dimensions.consequential_choice: yes / no / unknown; a learner chooses or constructs a mathematically consequential object, measure or procedure, not merely a display format.
dimensions.approach_opportunities: Qualitative reasoning possibilities and anticipated limitations only; no claim of observed approach diversity.

evaluation.reporting: All nine attempts per method in denominators; calibration separate; counts by dimension and task family; cost as calls, available tokens and elapsed time. Unknown never counted as pass.
evaluation.decision: No automatic promotion. More supported, target-preserving, accessible, undisclosed tasks with consequential choices is a descriptive advantage; equal or lower counts is no demonstrated advantage. Report regressions and family differences even if that count improves.
evaluation.failure_policy: Keep all failed attempts and bounded revisions, do not substitute historical tasks or replace attempts.

limitations: Already inspected development directions, not untouched final topics.
Nine attempts per method is exploratory, not a powered sample-size calculation.
Same model and guidance but unequal calls; this compares whole methods, not decomposition alone.
No independent expert ratings, student attempts or learning outcomes.
Pipeline token usage may be unavailable in the existing diagnostic trace.
No iteration or feedback-based refinement in this round.
